scientific_integrity: Proof supplies a complete eight-word enumeration, a forced-length argument and explicit witnesses; finite exhaustive executable checks corroborate but are not used to infer an unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: The exact conclusion is a sharp first-obstruction classification for total lengths at most eight; no characterization of spectra at greater lengths, automatic novel-priority certification, or independent mathematical replication is asserted. Previously published endpoint criteria and partition correspondences are acknowledged as ingredients.
title: The first gap in binary Parikh-matrix subsequence-universality spectra
